summary.text: Brian Deer is the Democratic candidate for Ohio State Senate District 17 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Shane Wilkin.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Deer described himself as a retired law enforcement officer and former small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Brian Deer earned a high school diploma from Rock Hill High School and a degree from the Ohio Peace Officer Training Academy in 1991.
His career experience includes working as a coach and in law enforcement.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026, in which he was the only candidate.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Deer listed protecting Ohio public school funding under the Fair School Funding Plan, protecting Medicare and Medicaid funding, and letting small stores buy from vendors at prices closer to those offered to larger stores as his key campaign messages.
He said he is personally passionate about public education funding and about expanding and protecting collective bargaining.
He named the Ohio Federation of Teachers and AFSCME Ohio Council 8 as organizations that have endorsed his campaign.
